title: Great Expectations
description: The story of Pip, an orphan who rises from humble beginnings to gentleman status, and his love for the cold-hearted Estella.

title: To Kill a Mockingbird
description: The story of Scout Finch's childhood in Alabama, her father Atticus Finch, and the trial of a black man accused of raping a white woman.

title: The Great Gatsby
description: The story of the mysterious Jay Gatsby and his obsession with the wealthy Daisy Buchanan, set during the Roaring Twenties.

title: Pride and Prejudice
description: The story of the outspoken Elizabeth Bennet and her love-hate relationship with the wealthy Mr. Darcy.
A dystopian novel set in a totalitarian society where 'Big Brother' watches everyone.

title: Moby-Dick
description: The voyage of the whaling ship Pequod, commanded by Captain Ahab, who seeks revenge on the giant white sperm whale Moby Dick.

title: The Catcher in the Rye
description: The story of Holden Caulfield's experiences in New York City after being expelled from prep school.

title: Jane Eyre
description: The story of the strong-willed orphan Jane Eyre and her love for Mr. Rochester.

title: Crime and Punishment
description: The psychological thriller of Raskolnikov, a young ex-law student who commits a heinous crime and tries to justify it.

title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
description: The story of a young man, Dorian Gray, who remains young and handsome while his portrait ages and shows the effects of his moral corruption.

title: The Hobbit
description: The prelude to 'The Lord of the Rings,' following the journey of the hobbit Bilbo Baggins.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
description: The multi-generational story of the Buendía family in the fictional town of Macondo, blending magical and realist elements.

title: Don Quixote
description: The story of an aging nobleman who, driven mad by reading too many chivalric romances, sets out to revive chivalry under the name Don Quixote.

title: Anna Karenina
description: The tragic story of the aristocrat Anna Karenina and her affair with the affluent Count Vronsky.

title: War and Peace
description: A historical novel that chronicles the history of the French invasion of Russia and the impact of the Napoleonic era on Tsarist society through the stories of five Russian aristocratic families.

title: Wuthering Heights
description: The passionate and tragic love story of Heathcliff and Catherine Earnshaw, set on the Yorkshire moors.

title: Frankenstein
description: The story of Victor Frankenstein and the creature he brings to life, exploring themes of ambition and responsibility.

title: The Brothers Karamazov
description: The philosophical novel exploring faith, doubt, and morality through the story of the Karamazov family.

title: The War of the Worlds
description: The science fiction novel about an alien invasion of Earth.

title: The Odyssey
description: The epic poem following the Greek hero Odysseus on his journey home from the Trojan War.

title: The Count of Monte Cristo
description: The story of Edmond Dantès, a young sailor falsely imprisoned who escapes and seeks revenge.

title: Inferno
description: The first part of Dante's Divine Comedy, depicting Dante's journey through Hell, guided by the ancient Roman poet Virgil.

title: Les Misérables
description: The story of Jean Valjean, an ex-convict who seeks redemption while pursued by the relentless Inspector Javert.

title: The Metamorphosis
description: The novella tells the story of Gregor Samsa, who wakes one morning to find himself transformed into a giant insect-like creature.

title: Gulliver's Travels
description: The satirical travel narrative of Lemuel Gulliver and his encounters with strange civilizations and societies.

title: Middlemarch
description: A portrait of the lives of the residents of the fictitious English town of Middlemarch.

title: Dracula
description: The Gothic horror novel that tells the story of Count Dracula's attempt to move from Transylvania to England so he may find new blood and spread the undead curse.

title: Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
description: The story of Huck Finn's adventures on the Mississippi River with the runaway slave Jim.
